Notes about this site and a standing offer, kept off the main pages.

## Errors and corrections

I offer €5 for minor errors, €15 for moderate errors, and €40 for major errors in my work. While it's difficult to define these categories in advance, I aim to be fair in my assessments.

Very minor errors (typos, grammatical mistakes) earn my gratitude.

If you prefer not to receive a reward, I'll donate the equivalent amount to GiveWell.

Contact me via email if you want a reward, or use the [anonymous feedback form](https://www.admonymous.co/kjappelbaum) if you prefer anonymity.

## Consulting and mentoring

I give two hours a month of pro-bono consultation to non-profits and organisations working for the public good who think they can use my experience in machine learning, chemistry, and data management. I am also open to paid consulting for for-profit organisations. Either way, email me.

Students looking for mentoring should go through the lab's [mentoring programme](https://lamalab.org/mentoring/) rather than writing to me directly.

## Subscribing

New notes go out over [RSS](index.xml). If you would rather have them by email, [Blogtrottr](https://blogtrottr.com) will forward the feed at `https://kjablonka.com/index.xml`.

## About this site

Built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org), set in IBM Plex Mono, and [open source](https://github.com/kjappelbaum/kjappelbaum.github.io). Citation counts on this site are refreshed automatically from Google Scholar; the date shown is the last check.
